# LLM-based-semantic-extraction

When enabled, the runner invokes a semantic extractor backed by an LLM provider and a database-backed cache to augment deterministic facts with semantic facts. The extractor is constrained by a max_calls_per_run limit and returns warnings; budget exhaustion is treated as a resumable fatal error.
